notes: delta = WR vs enemy - 50 (= rivalsmeta Difference column / 2); WR vs enemy = rivalsmeta Counters table (Diamond+) (delta, percentage points). Min 1500 head-to-head matches.

teamUps.name: Savage Slam
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Leap high and smash the ground, dealing damage to enemies and reducing the cooldowns of other abilities based on remaining Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, the ground slam additionally applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

teamUps.name: Gamma Fastball
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enter a Furious state upon activation, gaining Speed Boost and Attack Speed for a duration. Also unlocks the Scars of Rage ability, granting Unstoppable for a period when Health drops to a certain threshold.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Wolverine, unlocks the Fastball Special. Upon mutual confirmation, Hulk hurls Wolverine forward and enters Furious state.

teamUps.name: Gamma Maelstrom
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Gamma Maelstrom. This drastically boosts energy charge rates and removes the Anti-Heal curse.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Gamma Maelstrom retains some energy, and stored Gamma energy doesn't decay over time.

teamUps.name: Gamma Charge
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Armor Overdrive to Gamma Overdrive. In this state, Iron Man gains a Gamma Shield and can fire stronger Repulsor Blasts and Unibeams.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Invincible Invincible Pulse Cannon generates a Gamma Shield and heavily infuses the blast, creating a Gamma Pulse Cannon. Its radiation creates a damage increase while the projectile flies.

teamUps.name: Gamma Monstro
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Summon an extra Gamma Monstro that continuously damages the nearest enemy. Upon landing critical hits, the Gamma Monstro gains increased Attack Speed. Hitting an enemy with Wrath of the Seven Seas prompts it to fire a powerful beam.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, casting Blessing of the Deep creates a water barrier infused with Gamma energy. Standing inside accelerates the Gamma Monstro cooldown and grants it a Damage Boost.

teamUps.name: Ammo Overload
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Throw an Ammo Overload Device in the target direction. Upon entering the device's range, receive Faster Firing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo and Faster Firing.

teamUps.name: Bestial Hunt
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Shoot piercing bullets that carry a Damage Boost effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Daredevil, the bullets break enemy summoned walls and shields more quickly.

teamUps.name: Timeless Veterans
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unlocks the Burst Spike ability. Using the bionic arm emits forward electricity, dealing damage and Knocking Back enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the electric burst applies a Grounded effect and Knocks Back enemies even further.

teamUps.name: Primal Punishment
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Adds a new ability. Upon activation, Primal Bite is replaced. Devil Dinosaur gains 2 magnetic cannons that can be fired forward; the cannonballs detonate when hitting enemies or the environment, applying Bleed.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the duo can request an interaction. Once accepted, The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher.

teamUps.name: Gods Of Thunder
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Wind Blade into a hitscan lightning beam that detonates upon striking a target.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor,Bolt Rush becomes Chain Lightning, allowing it to bounce from foe to foe.

teamUps.name: Jaws Of Fate
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a torrential downpour that continuously heals both herself and her teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, casting Omega Hurricane allows Jeff to swim inside the cyclone, generating a localized Jeff-nado.

teamUps.name: Storming Ignition
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a storm-driven blaze of fire forward, generating a persistent Fire Vortex upon impact that continuously damages and pulls in enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, her Omega Hurricane ignites into a Burning Hurricane if it crosses a Flame Tornado. Furthermore, any Omega Hurricane, Jeff-Nado, or Burning Hurricane that sweeps across a Flame Field left by Human Torch will instantly generate a new Flame Tornado.

teamUps.name: Damisa-Yao
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Trigger the elemental power stored within his armor, dealing damage and applying Slow to surrounding enemies while attaching Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, enemies within range are launched toward Black Panther.

teamUps.name: Cosmic Cyclone
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

teamUps.name: Vibrant Vitality
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Regeneration Domain provides a Damage Boost effect to allies within range; the Runestone triggers a psychic catalysis, expanding the domain's radius.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, deploying Regeneration Domain emits a shockwave of nature energy that damages enemies within the radius and slightly Launches them up.

teamUps.name: Villain'S Illusion
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to target fallen heroes (friend or foe), letting Loki assume their form for a set time (cannot cast their Ultimate Ability).
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, Loki's transformation lasts slightly longer. Furthermore, taking lethal damage while transformed or in his Ultimate Ability state will merely revert him back to Loki with some Health, preventing a KO.

teamUps.name: Odin'S Unacknowledged
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

teamUps.name: Fiery Sparks
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Passively detect enemies in the immediate vicinity and launch tracking Firework Sparks to chip away their health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, successfully landing a Firework Spark on an enemy grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

teamUps.name: Storming Ignition
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a storm-driven blaze of fire forward, generating a persistent Fire Vortex upon impact that continuously damages and pulls in enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, her Omega Hurricane ignites into a Burning Hurricane if it crosses a Flame Tornado. Furthermore, any Omega Hurricane, Jeff-Nado, or Burning Hurricane that sweeps across a Flame Field left by Human Torch will instantly generate a new Flame Tornado.

teamUps.name: United Siblings
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Generate a Flame Shield for a targeted ally that blocks incoming damage while providing a Continuous Healing aura to everyone nearby. Projectiles from teammates shot through the Flame Shield receive a Damage Boost. Enemies that pass though the shield are Slowed
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, the Flame Shield boasts a larger radius and heavily increased shield value.

teamUps.name: Two-In-One
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enter an enhanced state upon activation. For the duration, The Thing's fists are violently engulfed in flames. Every Rocky Jab deals splash damage, and every Stone Haymaker creates an explosion, dealing damage in a frontal cone.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage and Stun to enemies. The Thing then automatically enters his flaming enhanced state upon landing.

teamUps.name: Gamma Maelstrom
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Gamma Maelstrom. This drastically boosts energy charge rates and removes the Anti-Heal curse.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Gamma Maelstrom retains some energy, and stored Gamma energy doesn't decay over time.

teamUps.name: Psionic Vortex
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Psionic Vortex. Enemies caught in are Launched toward you. Shield of the Seraphim also gains increased shield value.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Invisible Woman, any damage dealt by Psionic Vortex provides proportional Bonus Health for Doctor Strange.

teamUps.name: Chain Of Cyttorak
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Chain of Cyttorak can tether two enemies simultaneously, dragging both targets to the same location.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, Chain of Cyttorak can tether multiple enemies at once, pulling the entire group to a singular point.

teamUps.name: Sorcerers Supreme
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cooldown-based ability. Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, this becomes a toggleable ability. Toggle to replace Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst.

teamUps.name: Vibrant Vitality
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Regeneration Domain provides a Damage Boost effect to allies within range; the Runestone triggers a psychic catalysis, expanding the domain's radius.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, deploying Regeneration Domain emits a shockwave of nature energy that damages enemies within the radius and slightly Launches them up.

teamUps.name: Star Blossom
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate with the effect enhances and spreads the healing aura.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, using Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced spell field and healing effect.

teamUps.name: Vitality Pact
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upon defeat, Mantis can freely move as a soul, healing nearby allies, and reforge her body at a chosen spot. After using Natural Anger, the effect of Nature's Favor is enhanced, increasing the amount of healing provided.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, her soul state can forge Soul Bond with nearby teammates, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond.

teamUps.name: Wild Wall
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Summon a Wild Wall that provides Continuous Healing and Bonus Health to allies within its range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, the Wild Wall evolves after providing a certain amount of healing, increasing its healing.

teamUps.name: Spirit Breaker
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Damaging an enemy's sentience directly converts that damage into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, shattering a sentience grants one-time Bonus Health while simultaneously reducing the cooldown of Psychic Spear.

teamUps.name: Moonlit Slash
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Crescent Slash to Moonlit Slash, projecting a radiant slash outward. It heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, Moonlit Slash can be chained into a three-hit combo, firing off three consecutive sweeping light blades.

teamUps.name: Senbonzakura Strike
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Blast Arrow to Psionic Arrow. While drawn, Hawkeye can continuously bank extra Psionic Arrows. Releasing the bowstring fires all accumulated arrows forward simultaneously.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the nocking speed for each Psionic Arrow is significantly quickened, and they explode upon hitting enemies or the environment.

teamUps.name: Allied Agents
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Landing hits with Red Room Rifle builds Focus. At three stacks, enter a Focused state where the next bullet gains the Hunter's Sight effect, granting Damage Boost and pierce effects.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hawkeye, landing a critical hit prevents the Focused state from expiring, allowing continuous enhanced fire until missing a crit.

teamUps.name: Savage Slam
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Leap high and smash the ground, dealing damage to enemies and reducing the cooldowns of other abilities based on remaining Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, the ground slam additionally applies Vulnerability to enemies hit.

teamUps.name: Voltaic Union
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Modify Sentinel Strike into a Lightning Shield projectile. After landing two hits, Captain America launches the piercing Lightning Shield four times.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, the lightning energy imbued in the shield intensifies. Each hit from the Lightning Shield triggers an extra burst of damage in the surrounding area.

teamUps.name: Stars Aligned
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Captain America can leap directly to a teammate, providing Bonus Health to both himself and the ally, while redirecting a portion of their incoming damage to himself.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Winter Soldier, the duo can trigger a mutual rally. Upon confirmation, they charge at one another, slamming together to grant Bonus Health and Movement Speed to all nearby friends. The original effect remains; now additionally granting a Speed Boost to the targeted teammate.

teamUps.name: Bleed For Battle
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: For every set amount of damage taken, Blade builds a stack of Bloodline Awakening. Also raises the overall stack cap.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, taking critical damage instantly triggers the Bloodline Awakening state, gaining bonus stacks while continuing to raise the overall stack cap.

teamUps.name: Ammo Overload
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Throw an Ammo Overload Device in the target direction. Upon entering the device's range, receive Faster Firing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the device grants Infinite Ammo and Faster Firing.

teamUps.name: Planet X Pals
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Convert Bombard Mode to launch Thorny Spores. Upon impact, they deal continuous damage to enemies within the radius while healing and granting Bonus Health to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, Rocket can ride on Groot's shoulders, and the active duration of the Thorny Spores field is extended.

teamUps.name: Mammalian Bond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Toss out a scattered batch of augmented Vitality Acorns. Acorns that hit the floor can be collected. Whether struck directly or picked up, teammates receive a burst of healing and global cooldown reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Squirrel Girl, the maximum charge count for this ability is increased.

teamUps.name: Fantastic Amplifier
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Equips the Fantastic Amplifier. For the duration, Mister Fantastic's maximum Elasticity is increased, and he can actively enter Inflation State.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, Brainiac Bounce Launches hit enemies.

teamUps.name: Rocket Network
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Armored Spider-Nest that periodically drops Spider-Drones and Armor Packs that grant Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the Armored Spider-Nest passively regenerates its own Health. Furthermore, Rocket's B.R.B. will generate Cyber-Webs, and spawn both Spider-Drones and Arachno-Mines.

teamUps.name: Villain'S Illusion
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to target fallen heroes (friend or foe), letting Loki assume their form for a set time (cannot cast their Ultimate Ability).
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, Loki's transformation lasts slightly longer. Furthermore, taking lethal damage while transformed or in his Ultimate Ability state will merely revert him back to Loki with some Health, preventing a KO.

teamUps.name: Hel Tendrils
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Replace Soul Drainer with Hel Tendrils. Upon hit, tendrils pull nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, Slowingenemies that try to escape.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Piercing Night fires a dense volley of symbiote-infused Nightsword Thorns. Each direct Nightsword Thorn hit restores a portion of Hela's Health.

teamUps.name: Deep Wrath
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Whenever Hela participates in a KO, an Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position. While an Undead Monstro is present, casting Piercing Night will command the Monstro to spit a Nightsword Thorn at the nearest enemy.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Namor, each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

teamUps.name: Ragnarok Rebirth
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Receiving fatal damage prevents immediate defeat, Thor gains a decaying pool of Bonus Health. If he participates in a KO during this time, he resurrects and recovers a small amount of Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, if either of them participates in a KO, Thor instantly revives, restoring Health equal to his remaining Bonus Health and gaining a Continuous Healing effect.

teamUps.name: Circle Of Life
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Psionic Detonation is replaced by Phoenix Netherfire, applying a Telekinetic Mark to the targeted location. Upon hitting, it triggers an initial small explosion that briefly Stuns enemies, followed by two larger explosions that apply a Healing Reduction effect. Every single blast inflicts Sparks onto the enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, every blast in the sequence applies multiple stacks of Sparks to enemies caught within.

teamUps.name: "Hel-Yeah, Honey"
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Receive upgrades from Hel, allowing the Desert Eagles or Katanas to be upgraded one additional time. Hel-Yeah Desert Eagles: Duelist and Vanguard gain pierce, and the thought bubbles transform into homing death-rattle bubbles. Strategist death-rattle bubbles also home in on allies, exploding to provide healing. Hel-Yeah Katanas: Every strike injects undead energy into the enemy. Hitting an enemy three times with the Katanas detonates the energy, dealing percentage-based true damage scaling off their max Health. Strategist gains additional healing when unleashing the undead energy.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, BOTH the Desert Eagles and Katanas can be upgraded one extra time.

teamUps.name: Moonlit Slash
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Crescent Slash to Moonlit Slash, projecting a radiant slash outward. It heals and boosts healing for allies, while damaging enemies and applying Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, Moonlit Slash can be chained into a three-hit combo, firing off three consecutive sweeping light blades.

teamUps.name: Oblivion Shroud
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Veil of Lightforce and Terror Cape are warped by void magic, changing into Twilight Veil and Void Veil while retaining their original effects, after traveling a set distance, the veils halt in place. Enemy damage passing through the Twilight Veil is weakened, while enemy healing passing through the Void Veil suffers Healing Reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the width of both the Twilight Veil and Void Veil expands. Additionally, allies passing through the veils are empowered by hellfire energy, gaining Damage Boost for a duration.

teamUps.name: Frozen Haven
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Channel frost energy outward to encase yourself in an absolute block of ice. This offers great protection, but Freezes you in place. While frozen, you can be healed and emit a weak healing aura to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the healing aura provided to allies while Frozen becomes significantly stronger.

teamUps.name: Luminous Moon
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enter Phased state and dash forward while emitting a Light Energy Healing Wave that heals Moon Knight and nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the Phased state duration is extended and the dash distance increases. Upon ending, Moon Knight gains Continuous Healing, while the radius of the Light Energy Healing Wave is expanded and its healing output increased.

teamUps.name: Light & Dark Darts
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a ring of Light Darts in all directions that damage enemies and restore Psylocke's Health upon impact, leaving behind a Shadow Domain. Staying inside the domain for a short time will re-enter Stealth.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the radius of the Shadow Domain expands, and each time re-entering Stealth, the Light Darts are fired in all directions again.

teamUps.name: Damisa-Yao
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Trigger the elemental power stored within his armor, dealing damage and applying Slow to surrounding enemies while attaching Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, enemies within range are launched toward Black Panther.

teamUps.name: Dimensional Shortcut
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activate a Limbo stepping disc to instantly return to your position from a few seconds ago, gaining Bonus Health in the process. When the teleport ends, the disc collapses in an explosion, damaging nearby enemies and applying Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magik, the teleportation sequence can be manually canceled mid-transit.

teamUps.name: Vibranium Mech
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, deploy a frontal Vibranium Shield while Cyber-Web Cluster gains an Attack Speed Boost for a set duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, the Vibranium Shield is expanded, and its active time increased.

teamUps.name: Feline Alliance
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Taking damage accumulates Vibranium Energy. Upon reaching a specific threshold, Black Cat can unleash a violent explosion, damaging and Knocking back surrounding enemies while gaining a brief Speed Boost and Bonus Health. For every enemy hit, gain 50 Fortune, up to a max of 100.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the Vibranium Energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

teamUps.name: Planet X Pals
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Convert Bombard Mode to launch Thorny Spores. Upon impact, they deal continuous damage to enemies within the radius while healing and granting Bonus Health to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, Rocket can ride on Groot's shoulders, and the active duration of the Thorny Spores field is extended.

teamUps.name: Wild Wall
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Summon a Wild Wall that provides Continuous Healing and Bonus Health to allies within its range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, the Wild Wall evolves after providing a certain amount of healing, increasing its healing.

teamUps.name: Bubble Buddies
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Retreat inside a Bubble Shield to enter an Invincible state, granting self-targeted Continuous Healing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, the healing effect inside the bubble is enhanced, and any excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

teamUps.name: Flora Munitions
teamUps.text:
Gain a new ability to toss Twisted Thorn Seeds forward. Upon landing, they rapidly Sprout and take root, generating Thorn Snares around the area. Enemies stepping on a snare take damage and suffer a Root effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, the number of Thorn Snares deployed increases, and the damage dealt when an enemy steps on them is boosted.

teamUps.name: Stark Protocol
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Encephalo-Ray to Nano-Ray, firing multiple nano-projectiles forward that damage enemies and heal allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, Imperative: Firewall fires powerful homing missiles at enemies in range, causing area damage.

teamUps.name: Sp//Dr Sync
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Apply Imperative: Patch to all allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Imperative: Firewall applies to all Drones, allowing the ability effects to be triggered multiple times simultaneously.

teamUps.name: Flawless Design
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

teamUps.name: Dimensional Shortcut
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activate a Limbo stepping disc to instantly return to your position from a few seconds ago, gaining Bonus Health in the process. When the teleport ends, the disc collapses in an explosion, damaging nearby enemies and applying Vibranium Marks.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magik, the teleportation sequence can be manually canceled mid-transit.

teamUps.name: Chain Of Cyttorak
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Chain of Cyttorak can tether two enemies simultaneously, dragging both targets to the same location.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, Chain of Cyttorak can tether multiple enemies at once, pulling the entire group to a singular point.

teamUps.name: Void Pentagram
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Casting Stepping Discs within an Void Magic Circle refunds energy, and each use of Stepping Discs summons a Limbo Demon.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the summoned Limbo Demons have heavily increased Health and a wider attack range.

teamUps.name: Luminous Moon
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enter Phased state and dash forward while emitting a Light Energy Healing Wave that heals Moon Knight and nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the Phased state duration is extended and the dash distance increases. Upon ending, Moon Knight gains Continuous Healing, while the radius of the Light Energy Healing Wave is expanded and its healing output increased.

teamUps.name: Blood Moon
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Ankh Trap. Upon triggering, an Ankh materializes at the location, while summoning a single Talon of Khonshu to Launch enemies toward the trap's center.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, triggering the trap summons multiple Talons of Khonshu to bombard the area.

teamUps.name: Blade Of Khonshu
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Perform a heavy forward cleave with the Ancestral Sword while performing a short dash. At the end of the dash, swiftly slash four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, each Whirlwind Slash triggered generates one additional Darkmoon Blade.

teamUps.name: Frozen Haven
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Channel frost energy outward to encase yourself in an absolute block of ice. This offers great protection, but Freezes you in place. While frozen, you can be healed and emit a weak healing aura to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the healing aura provided to allies while Frozen becomes significantly stronger.

teamUps.name: Atlas Bond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a spirit fox forward that Charmsenemies while healing any allies in its path.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with White Fox, the spirit fox automatically returns after reaching its maximum distance.

teamUps.name: Duality Dance
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cast Soul Bond to tether all characters within range. Attacking tethered enemies or healing linked allies restores your Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, scoring critical hits with Light & Dark Ice reduces the cooldowns of Absolute Zero and Ice Arts.

teamUps.name: Chilling Charisma
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to summon a Frost Tide forward. The wave damages, Pushes Back, and inflicts a Slow on all enemies hit. Additionally, Monstro Spawns are replaced by Frozen Spawns, which apply a Slow to enemies they hit.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the Frost Tide gains 1 charge and crashes down upon reaching its maximum range, dealing area damage and Slowing enemies caught near the endpoint.

teamUps.name: Iced Out Diamond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. In diamond form, condense frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, entering Diamond Form imbues all damaging abilities with a Slow effect. Telepathic Pulse will also inflict a Slow effect.

teamUps.name: Mammalian Bond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Toss out a scattered batch of augmented Vitality Acorns. Acorns that hit the floor can be collected. Whether struck directly or picked up, teammates receive a burst of healing and global cooldown reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Squirrel Girl, the maximum charge count for this ability is increased.

teamUps.name: Squirrel Missile
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain the Squirrel Missile ability. Squirrel Girl directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, using Squirrel Blockade simultaneously fires a Squirrel Missile.

teamUps.name: Esu Alumnus
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb. She can launch it to unleash an explosion upon contact with the environment or an enemy, briefly Slowing and damaging enemies caught in the blast. It simultaneously generates a Web Area that applies a Grounded effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, Squirrel Girl receives more Web Fluid. After throwing Webbed Acorn, viscous web fluid coats the ground alongside the explosion, leaving behind a sticky Web Area. Enemies within suffer continuous Slow and Grounded effects that scale into a Stun if they linger too long.

teamUps.name: Allied Agents
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Landing hits with Red Room Rifle builds Focus. At three stacks, enter a Focused state where the next bullet gains the Hunter's Sight effect, granting Damage Boost and pierce effects.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hawkeye, landing a critical hit prevents the Focused state from expiring, allowing continuous enhanced fire until missing a crit.

teamUps.name: Burning Bullets
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants the Red Room Rifle a Fire Rate Boost. Additionally, the Plasma Cannon projectile becomes a hitscan laser that no longer requires charging.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, her Plasma Cannon gains a second ability charge.

teamUps.name: Devilish Affair
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Swings Devil's Chain in a criss-cross pattern, dealing damage to enemies in front and inflicting a Slow. 
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Widow, the damage radius is expanded, and landing hits recovers Fury.

teamUps.name: Stark Protocol
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Encephalo-Ray to Nano-Ray, firing multiple nano-projectiles forward that damage enemies and heal allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, Imperative: Firewall fires powerful homing missiles at enemies in range, causing area damage.

teamUps.name: Squirrel Missile
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain the Squirrel Missile ability. Squirrel Girl directs a squirrel to ride Iron Man's nanotech glove as a homing missile. Upon hit, the squirrel flees just before a fiery explosion.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Man, using Squirrel Blockade simultaneously fires a Squirrel Missile.

teamUps.name: Gamma Charge
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Armor Overdrive to Gamma Overdrive. In this state, Iron Man gains a Gamma Shield and can fire stronger Repulsor Blasts and Unibeams.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, releasing Invincible Invincible Pulse Cannon generates a Gamma Shield and heavily infuses the blast, creating a Gamma Pulse Cannon. Its radiation creates a damage increase while the projectile flies.

teamUps.name: Thunder Overdrive
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enhance Unibeam both in and out of Armor Overdrive. When fired, a ring of volatile lightning energy forms, dealing bonus damage to enemies caught near the beam's edge.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, Armor Overdrive cooldown is massively reduced.

teamUps.name: Hel Tendrils
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Replace Soul Drainer with Hel Tendrils. Upon hit, tendrils pull nearby enemies toward the impact point and links them, Slowingenemies that try to escape.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, Piercing Night fires a dense volley of symbiote-infused Nightsword Thorns. Each direct Nightsword Thorn hit restores a portion of Hela's Health.

teamUps.name: Blood Leech
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cellular Corrosion new effect: while tethered to enemies, continuously siphon health from every linked target, restoring Venom's Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using certain specific abilities.

teamUps.name: Abyssal Flames
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Ignite the symbiote with Phoenix Flames for a duration, replacing Dark Predation with a sweeping Avian Claw frontal slash.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Venom's Phoenix Force is enhanced: every Avian Claw applies a Spark. Upon reaching three stacks, the Sparks detonate.

teamUps.name: Symbiote Bond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Venom shares a part of his symbiote with Spider-Man, activating their symbiote abilities. Spider-Man can convert the symbiotes into explosive spikes that inflict harm on nearby enemies and relentlessly drive them back.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, this triggers additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils that continuously tether and damage enemies on top of the base effect.

teamUps.name: Guardian Of The Deep
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Shoot out healing tendrils; linked allies receive Continuous Healing, and excess healing is converted into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, symbiote tendrils can also lash out at nearby enemies within range, inflicting continuous damage.

teamUps.name: Esu Alumnus
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Spider-Man gives Squirrel Girl a web bomb. She can launch it to unleash an explosion upon contact with the environment or an enemy, briefly Slowing and damaging enemies caught in the blast. It simultaneously generates a Web Area that applies a Grounded effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, Squirrel Girl receives more Web Fluid. After throwing Webbed Acorn, viscous web fluid coats the ground alongside the explosion, leaving behind a sticky Web Area. Enemies within suffer continuous Slow and Grounded effects that scale into a Stun if they linger too long.

teamUps.name: Symbiote Bond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Venom shares a part of his symbiote with Spider-Man, activating their symbiote abilities. Spider-Man can convert the symbiotes into explosive spikes that inflict harm on nearby enemies and relentlessly drive them back.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, this triggers additional Touch of Klyntar tendrils that continuously tether and damage enemies on top of the base effect.

teamUps.name: Parker Power-Up
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Spider-Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging all Web-Cluster shots.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Spider-Tracers applied by Web-Cluster are upgraded. Detonating these upgraded marks generates Bonus Health for Spider-Man.

teamUps.name: Binding Ties
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Turn of Fortune is replaced by Spider-Web Grapple, which has 2 charges. Landing the grapple on an enemy steals Fortune and applies a Spider-Tracer. If Black Cat hits an enemy carrying a Spider-Tracer with any other ability, she triggers the mark to deal bonus damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, using Spider-Web Grapple to hit an enemy already marked with a Spider-Tracer temporarily Immobilizes them in place.

teamUps.name: Metallic Chaos
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Swing a colossal Chaos Greatsword forward to inflict damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, Mag-Cannon transforms into a charged ability that consumes his passive energy bar. For every tick of energy burned, a Chaos Greatsword is fired, dealing damage to enemies and inflicting a Launch Up effect.

teamUps.name: Magnetic Resonance
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cast a magnetic projection that mimics Magneto's movement and ability casts perfectly from the enemy's perspective.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, the magnetic projection receives a massive Health bump and will persist indefinitely unless destroyed or manually recalled.

teamUps.name: Favorable Odds
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launching enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

teamUps.name: Explosive Entanglement
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Defensive Stance is fortified. Activating the ability expands a magnetic field, drastically boosting the Damage Reduction ratio of Defensive Stance. Furthermore, all damage absorbed by the field is converted directly into damage for Southern Brawl.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, Southern Brawl Knocks back enemies. Extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

teamUps.name: Metallic Chaos
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Swing a colossal Chaos Greatsword forward to inflict damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Scarlet Witch, Mag-Cannon transforms into a charged ability that consumes his passive energy bar. For every tick of energy burned, a Chaos Greatsword is fired, dealing damage to enemies and inflicting a Launch Up effect.

teamUps.name: Sorcerers Supreme
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cooldown-based ability. Chthonian Burst is replaced with Mystic Burst. Hold down the attack button to unleash a rapid, relentless salvo of magical missiles in the target direction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Doctor Strange, this becomes a toggleable ability. Toggle to replace Chthonian Burst with Mystic Burst.

teamUps.name: Hex Fireworks
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Infuse firework energy into the Dark Seal forcefield, turning it into a Plasmoid Seal, allowing for a secondary blast. After expanding the Plasmoid Seal, pressing the SHIFT key again while it persists will detonate the fireworks, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing from the firework energy while using Mystic Projection.

teamUps.name: Gods Of Thunder
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Wind Blade into a hitscan lightning beam that detonates upon striking a target.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor,Bolt Rush becomes Chain Lightning, allowing it to bounce from foe to foe.

teamUps.name: Voltaic Union
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Modify Sentinel Strike into a Lightning Shield projectile. After landing two hits, Captain America launches the piercing Lightning Shield four times.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, the lightning energy imbued in the shield intensifies. Each hit from the Lightning Shield triggers an extra burst of damage in the surrounding area.

teamUps.name: Thunder Overdrive
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enhance Unibeam both in and out of Armor Overdrive. When fired, a ring of volatile lightning energy forms, dealing bonus damage to enemies caught near the beam's edge.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Thor, Armor Overdrive cooldown is massively reduced.

teamUps.name: Ragnarok Rebirth
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Receiving fatal damage prevents immediate defeat, Thor gains a decaying pool of Bonus Health. If he participates in a KO during this time, he resurrects and recovers a small amount of Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, if either of them participates in a KO, Thor instantly revives, restoring Health equal to his remaining Bonus Health and gaining a Continuous Healing effect.

teamUps.name: Divine Armory
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

teamUps.name: Fantastic Amplifier
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Equips the Fantastic Amplifier. For the duration, Mister Fantastic's maximum Elasticity is increased, and he can actively enter Inflation State.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, Brainiac Bounce Launches hit enemies.

teamUps.name: Clobberin' Research Dept.
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Toggle Ability. In brawler stance, Stretch Punch becomes a charged ability, firing a forward Brawling Punch. Hitting an enemy grants Bonus Health scaling with damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Thing, while in the brawling stance, Distended Grip also becomes a charged ability, slamming down a Distended Hammer. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health based on damage, and a full charge Launches hit enemies.

teamUps.name: First Family
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Invisible Woman and surrounding allies enter Invisible state, gaining healing and a Speed Boost. The effect ends if they take damage or the duration expires. Disengaging from combat for a duration will reenter the Invisible state.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mister Fantastic, the healing and Speed Boost effects are enhanced, and the Invisible state duration is increased.

teamUps.name: Stars Aligned
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Captain America can leap directly to a teammate, providing Bonus Health to both himself and the ally, while redirecting a portion of their incoming damage to himself.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Winter Soldier, the duo can trigger a mutual rally. Upon confirmation, they charge at one another, slamming together to grant Bonus Health and Movement Speed to all nearby friends. The original effect remains; now additionally granting a Speed Boost to the targeted teammate.

teamUps.name: Timeless Veterans
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unlocks the Burst Spike ability. Using the bionic arm emits forward electricity, dealing damage and Knocking Back enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the electric burst applies a Grounded effect and Knocks Back enemies even further.

teamUps.name: Expert Instinct
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Securing or participating in a KO grants a stack of Culling Instinct. Each stack reduces the cooldowns of Winter Soldier's other abilities. Stacks are lost upon defeat.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, the Bonus Health generated by Ceaseless Charge is increased.

teamUps.name: Sp//Dr Sync
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Apply Imperative: Patch to all allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Imperative: Firewall applies to all Drones, allowing the ability effects to be triggered multiple times simultaneously.

teamUps.name: Parker Power-Up
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Peni Parker whips up a Sticky Spider-Bomb for Spider-Man! Prime it, then toss it before the timer's up for a blast that damages nearby enemies and attaches a Spider-Tracer to them. If not thrown in time, it explodes on Spider-Man, recharging all Web-Cluster shots.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Peni Parker, Spider-Tracers applied by Web-Cluster are upgraded. Detonating these upgraded marks generates Bonus Health for Spider-Man.

teamUps.name: Vibranium Mech
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, deploy a frontal Vibranium Shield while Cyber-Web Cluster gains an Attack Speed Boost for a set duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, the Vibranium Shield is expanded, and its active time increased.

teamUps.name: Rocket Network
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Armored Spider-Nest that periodically drops Spider-Drones and Armor Packs that grant Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rocket Raccoon, the Armored Spider-Nest passively regenerates its own Health. Furthermore, Rocket's B.R.B. will generate Cyber-Webs, and spawn both Spider-Drones and Arachno-Mines.

teamUps.name: Star Blossom
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Recasting Healing Flower on a teammate with the effect enhances and spreads the healing aura.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, using Healing Flower on any teammate instantly triggers the enhanced spell field and healing effect.

teamUps.name: Flora Munitions
teamUps.text:
Gain a new ability to toss Twisted Thorn Seeds forward. Upon landing, they rapidly Sprout and take root, generating Thorn Snares around the area. Enemies stepping on a snare take damage and suffer a Root effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Groot, the number of Thorn Snares deployed increases, and the damage dealt when an enemy steps on them is boosted.

teamUps.name: Star-Soul
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to place a Telekinetic Beacon. You can teleport back to the location where the beacon is deployed from anywhere on the map. Upon defeat, Star-Lord will cocoon and respawn at the Telekinetic Beacon's coordinates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, every time Star-Lord participates in a KO, Telekinetic Beaconcooldown is reduced.

teamUps.name: Asgardians Of The Galaxy
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

teamUps.name: Blood Leech
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cellular Corrosion new effect: while tethered to enemies, continuously siphon health from every linked target, restoring Venom's Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, Venom gains a burst of one-time healing when using certain specific abilities.

teamUps.name: Blade Of Khonshu
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Perform a heavy forward cleave with the Ancestral Sword while performing a short dash. At the end of the dash, swiftly slash four times, each strike sending a Darkmoon Blade forward. When a Darkmoon Blade hits an enemy, it bounces to nearby targets.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Moon Knight, each Whirlwind Slash triggered generates one additional Darkmoon Blade.

teamUps.name: Bleed For Battle
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: For every set amount of damage taken, Blade builds a stack of Bloodline Awakening. Also raises the overall stack cap.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Captain America, taking critical damage instantly triggers the Bloodline Awakening state, gaining bonus stacks while continuing to raise the overall stack cap.

teamUps.name: Vampiric Kin
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Deploy a Vampiric Field. Allies standing within the field gain Life Steal when attacking enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, allies inside the field receive an additional Continuous Healing effect.

teamUps.name: Deep Wrath
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Whenever Hela participates in a KO, an Undead Monstro spawns at the fallen enemy's position. While an Undead Monstro is present, casting Piercing Night will command the Monstro to spit a Nightsword Thorn at the nearest enemy.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Namor, each attack during Goddess of Death spawns an Undead Monstro at the point of impact.

teamUps.name: Chilling Charisma
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to summon a Frost Tide forward. The wave damages, Pushes Back, and inflicts a Slow on all enemies hit. Additionally, Monstro Spawns are replaced by Frozen Spawns, which apply a Slow to enemies they hit.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, the Frost Tide gains 1 charge and crashes down upon reaching its maximum range, dealing area damage and Slowing enemies caught near the endpoint.

teamUps.name: Gamma Monstro
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Summon an extra Gamma Monstro that continuously damages the nearest enemy. Upon landing critical hits, the Gamma Monstro gains increased Attack Speed. Hitting an enemy with Wrath of the Seven Seas prompts it to fire a powerful beam.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hulk, casting Blessing of the Deep creates a water barrier infused with Gamma energy. Standing inside accelerates the Gamma Monstro cooldown and grants it a Damage Boost.

teamUps.name: Vitality Pact
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upon defeat, Mantis can freely move as a soul, healing nearby allies, and reforge her body at a chosen spot. After using Natural Anger, the effect of Nature's Favor is enhanced, increasing the amount of healing provided.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, her soul state can forge Soul Bond with nearby teammates, granting Healing Over Time and distributing damage taken across the bond.

teamUps.name: Duality Dance
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cast Soul Bond to tether all characters within range. Attacking tethered enemies or healing linked allies restores your Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, scoring critical hits with Light & Dark Ice reduces the cooldowns of Absolute Zero and Ice Arts.

teamUps.name: Star-Soul
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to place a Telekinetic Beacon. You can teleport back to the location where the beacon is deployed from anywhere on the map. Upon defeat, Star-Lord will cocoon and respawn at the Telekinetic Beacon's coordinates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Adam Warlock, every time Star-Lord participates in a KO, Telekinetic Beaconcooldown is reduced.

teamUps.name: Cosmic Cyclone
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Teammates linked by Soul Bond receive a Speed Boost.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Storm, linked teammates additionally gain a Damage Boost.

teamUps.name: Flawless Design
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cosmic Cluster now provides healing to allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Ultron, Cosmic Cluster creates an explosion upon impact.

teamUps.name: Jaws Of Fate
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a torrential downpour that continuously heals both herself and her teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, casting Omega Hurricane allows Jeff to swim inside the cyclone, generating a localized Jeff-nado.

teamUps.name: Bubble Buddies
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Retreat inside a Bubble Shield to enter an Invincible state, granting self-targeted Continuous Healing.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, the healing effect inside the bubble is enhanced, and any excess healing converts into Bonus Health.

teamUps.name: Guardian Of The Deep
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Shoot out healing tendrils; linked allies receive Continuous Healing, and excess healing is converted into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Venom, symbiote tendrils can also lash out at nearby enemies within range, inflicting continuous damage.

teamUps.name: Mr. Pool'S Interdimensional Toy Box
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Gain a new ability to spit out a Deadpool Plushie. The plushie continuously Taunts nearby enemies while spraying a healing mist onto surrounding allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, the Deadpool Plushie asserts a much stronger Taunt while concurrently damaging enemies caught in its radius.

teamUps.name: Surf & Turf
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Impact Beam is replaced by a frontal water spray. This stream damages enemies while providing healing to teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, Jeff can ride atop Devil Dinosaur's head. While riding, both gain some Damage Reduction and are swirled in therapeutic waters, receiving Continuous Healing.

teamUps.name: Senbonzakura Strike
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Blast Arrow to Psionic Arrow. While drawn, Hawkeye can continuously bank extra Psionic Arrows. Releasing the bowstring fires all accumulated arrows forward simultaneously.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the nocking speed for each Psionic Arrow is significantly quickened, and they explode upon hitting enemies or the environment.

teamUps.name: Light & Dark Darts
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a ring of Light Darts in all directions that damage enemies and restore Psylocke's Health upon impact, leaving behind a Shadow Domain. Staying inside the domain for a short time will re-enter Stealth.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cloak & Dagger, the radius of the Shadow Domain expands, and each time re-entering Stealth, the Light Darts are fired in all directions again.

teamUps.name: Mental Projection
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Create an illusory projection that automatically dashes forward to use Psi-Blade Dash, while Psylocke enters Stealth. If Psylocke attacks, the illusion mimics her strikes.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, Psylocke's mental powers are elevated, allowing her to reactivate the ability to instantly swap places with her illusion.

teamUps.name: Psionic Fox
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy, and grants the maximum possible duration immediately upon use.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the cooldown for Fox Form Awakening is drastically reduced.

teamUps.name: Gamma Fastball
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enter a Furious state upon activation, gaining Speed Boost and Attack Speed for a duration. Also unlocks the Scars of Rage ability, granting Unstoppable for a period when Health drops to a certain threshold.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Wolverine, unlocks the Fastball Special. Upon mutual confirmation, Hulk hurls Wolverine forward and enters Furious state.

teamUps.name: Pair Of Threes
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, Wolverine receives Kinetic Enhancement, gaining increased Movement Speed and a Jump Boost. Attacking enemies applies Kinetic Particles that detonate after a short delay for bonus damage. The effect lasts for duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the entire duration of the ability.

teamUps.name: Blast Slash
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activation extends the attack range of Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike. Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cyclops, Blast Slash is permanently active.

teamUps.name: Psionic Vortex
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upgrade Maelstrom of Madness to Psionic Vortex. Enemies caught in are Launched toward you. Shield of the Seraphim also gains increased shield value.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Invisible Woman, any damage dealt by Psionic Vortex provides proportional Bonus Health for Doctor Strange.

teamUps.name: United Siblings
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Generate a Flame Shield for a targeted ally that blocks incoming damage while providing a Continuous Healing aura to everyone nearby. Projectiles from teammates shot through the Flame Shield receive a Damage Boost. Enemies that pass though the shield are Slowed
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, the Flame Shield boasts a larger radius and heavily increased shield value.

teamUps.name: First Family
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Invisible Woman and surrounding allies enter Invisible state, gaining healing and a Speed Boost. The effect ends if they take damage or the duration expires. Disengaging from combat for a duration will reenter the Invisible state.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mister Fantastic, the healing and Speed Boost effects are enhanced, and the Invisible state duration is increased.

teamUps.name: Unbreakable Forces
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Generate a layer of Psionic Armor upon activation, granting Bonus Health scaling off currently missing Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up Invisible Woman, the Psionic Armor is fortified. While active, every time The Thing takes a set amount of damage, the armor pulses out a wave of area healing for allies. Furthermore, the conversion ratio for missing Health into Bonus Health is increased.

teamUps.name: Clobberin' Research Dept.
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Toggle Ability. In brawler stance, Stretch Punch becomes a charged ability, firing a forward Brawling Punch. Hitting an enemy grants Bonus Health scaling with damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Thing, while in the brawling stance, Distended Grip also becomes a charged ability, slamming down a Distended Hammer. Hitting enemies grants Bonus Health based on damage, and a full charge Launches hit enemies.

teamUps.name: Two-In-One
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Enter an enhanced state upon activation. For the duration, The Thing's fists are violently engulfed in flames. Every Rocky Jab deals splash damage, and every Stone Haymaker creates an explosion, dealing damage in a frontal cone.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Human Torch, Human Torch can lift The Thing into the air and slam him down, dealing damage and Stun to enemies. The Thing then automatically enters his flaming enhanced state upon landing.

teamUps.name: Unbreakable Forces
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Generate a layer of Psionic Armor upon activation, granting Bonus Health scaling off currently missing Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up Invisible Woman, the Psionic Armor is fortified. While active, every time The Thing takes a set amount of damage, the armor pulses out a wave of area healing for allies. Furthermore, the conversion ratio for missing Health into Bonus Health is increased.

teamUps.name: Iron & Stone
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a powerful uppercut to Launch Up enemies; can be followed up with a sweeping kick after release.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up The Thing, the uppercut can still be chained directly into a sweeping leg kick, and the damage dealt is increased.

teamUps.name: Kumiho Palm
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Yat Jee Chung Kuen provides a burst of healing to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up White Fox, the lock-on distance for Yat Jee Chung Kuen is significantly increased.

teamUps.name: Iron & Stone
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a powerful uppercut to Launch Up enemies; can be followed up with a sweeping kick after release.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up The Thing, the uppercut can still be chained directly into a sweeping leg kick, and the damage dealt is increased.

teamUps.name: Comprehensive Defense
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Objection! is enhanced. Whirling billy clubs now damage all enemies in range while deflecting Projectiles from all directions. Successfully deflecting attacks recovers Fury.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Fist, Daredevil passively recovers Health for the entire duration of the ability.

teamUps.name: Magnetic Resonance
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Cast a magnetic projection that mimics Magneto's movement and ability casts perfectly from the enemy's perspective.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, the magnetic projection receives a massive Health bump and will persist indefinitely unless destroyed or manually recalled.

teamUps.name: Mental Projection
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Create an illusory projection that automatically dashes forward to use Psi-Blade Dash, while Psylocke enters Stealth. If Psylocke attacks, the illusion mimics her strikes.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Emma Frost, Psylocke's mental powers are elevated, allowing her to reactivate the ability to instantly swap places with her illusion.

teamUps.name: Iced Out Diamond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Project ice energy forward, dealing damage and slowing enemies. In diamond form, condense frost into an Absolute Zero Diamond barrier that blocks enemy attacks and movement.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Luna Snow, entering Diamond Form imbues all damaging abilities with a Slow effect. Telepathic Pulse will also inflict a Slow effect.

teamUps.name: Spirit Breaker
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Damaging an enemy's sentience directly converts that damage into Bonus Health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Mantis, shattering a sentience grants one-time Bonus Health while simultaneously reducing the cooldown of Psychic Spear.

teamUps.name: Burning Bullets
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants the Red Room Rifle a Fire Rate Boost. Additionally, the Plasma Cannon projectile becomes a hitscan laser that no longer requires charging.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, her Plasma Cannon gains a second ability charge.

teamUps.name: Abyssal Flames
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Ignite the symbiote with Phoenix Flames for a duration, replacing Dark Predation with a sweeping Avian Claw frontal slash.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Venom's Phoenix Force is enhanced: every Avian Claw applies a Spark. Upon reaching three stacks, the Sparks detonate.

teamUps.name: Circle Of Life
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Psionic Detonation is replaced by Phoenix Netherfire, applying a Telekinetic Mark to the targeted location. Upon hitting, it triggers an initial small explosion that briefly Stuns enemies, followed by two larger explosions that apply a Healing Reduction effect. Every single blast inflicts Sparks onto the enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Hela, every blast in the sequence applies multiple stacks of Sparks to enemies caught within.

teamUps.name: Telekinetic Beatdown
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Fire a telekinetic shockwave forward. If it lands, the Phoenix Force rushes the enemy and delivers a powerful punch. If there are other targets nearby, the Phoenix Force rapidly blinks between them to strike them as well, inflicting a Spark on each victim while healing Phoenix.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Rogue, add an additional Spark stack, gain more healing, and increase the maximum number of strikes.

teamUps.name: Slim And Red
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Ricochet Force summons the Phoenix Force to ignite them, causing continuous burn damage over a set duration. Hitting an ignited target with Optic Blast or Concussive Beam instantly triggers a percentage of the remaining burn damage as a single burst.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Phoenix, Spark detonations reduce the cooldown of Ricochet Force.

teamUps.name: Bestial Hunt
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Shoot piercing bullets that carry a Damage Boost effect.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Daredevil, the bullets break enemy summoned walls and shields more quickly.

teamUps.name: Comprehensive Defense
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Objection! is enhanced. Whirling billy clubs now damage all enemies in range while deflecting Projectiles from all directions. Successfully deflecting attacks recovers Fury.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Iron Fist, Daredevil passively recovers Health for the entire duration of the ability.

teamUps.name: Devilish Affair
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Swings Devil's Chain in a criss-cross pattern, dealing damage to enemies in front and inflicting a Slow. 
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Widow, the damage radius is expanded, and landing hits recovers Fury.

teamUps.name: Divine Armory
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Hurl a Thunder Spear that restores Thorforce for each enemy struck. Afterward, Thor can leap to the spear's explosion point, dealing a second wave of damage to all enemies within range.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Angela, leaping to the Thunder Spear grants Bonus Health.

teamUps.name: Odin'S Unacknowledged
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Project an Illusion forward. The illusion utilizes Assassin's Charge to thrust at enemies. Enemies struck head-on will be carried through the air for a short while.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Loki, the ability gains two charges.

teamUps.name: Asgardians Of The Galaxy
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activation grants Reveal within a targeted area. Activating the ability again performs a slam attack; enemies hit by the slam are Grounded.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Star-Lord, Angela gains Bonus Health scaling with the number of enemies struck by the slam.

teamUps.name: Pair Of Threes
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Upon activation, Wolverine receives Kinetic Enhancement, gaining increased Movement Speed and a Jump Boost. Attacking enemies applies Kinetic Particles that detonate after a short delay for bonus damage. The effect lasts for duration.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Wolverine receives Continuous Healing for the entire duration of the ability.

teamUps.name: Gumbo Chimichangas
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activate for kinetic energy, propelling Deadpool in a forward leap. Upon landing, Duelist/Vanguard Deadpool scatters a ring of kinetically charged Chimichangas that deal damage to enemies. Strategist Deadpool's Chimichangas additionally heal allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, the kinetic energy causes Deadpool's landing to inflict a Stun effect on enemies in the blast radius.

teamUps.name: Favorable Odds
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Throw two magnetic playing cards forward. Upon hitting the environment or a character, the cards magnetically repel and unfurl, spinning in place for a duration. They heal allies they hit, while damaging and Launching enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, after the duration ends, the magnetic poles of the cards reverse. They violently slam back together and explode, providing an extra burst of healing to allies and damage to enemies.

teamUps.name: Sparkling Staff
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Twirl your firework-energy enhanced bo staff. The radiating firework sparks provide healing to nearby allies. Concurrently, the staff deals damage to close-range enemies, and the rapid spinning blocks incoming damage from most projectiles.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, both Bayou Bash and Big Easy Impact gain an additional Continuous Healing aura.

teamUps.name: Kinetic Kin
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Release stored kinetic energy to enter an enhanced state for a duration. While active, Cyclops gains significantly increased movement speed and jump height.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, during the enhanced state, the attack speeds for both Optic Blast and Concussive Beam are increased.

teamUps.name: Mr. & Mrs. X
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: After activation, every attack triggers a kinetic explosion, dealing area damage to surrounding enemies while simultaneously healing nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Gambit, Rogue remains permanently locked in the "Hearts as One" state.

teamUps.name: Blood Moon
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Deploy an Ankh Trap. Upon triggering, an Ankh materializes at the location, while summoning a single Talon of Khonshu to Launch enemies toward the trap's center.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, triggering the trap summons multiple Talons of Khonshu to bombard the area.

teamUps.name: Expert Instinct
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Securing or participating in a KO grants a stack of Culling Instinct. Each stack reduces the cooldowns of Winter Soldier's other abilities. Stacks are lost upon defeat.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Elsa Bloodstone, the Bonus Health generated by Ceaseless Charge is increased.

teamUps.name: Prehistoric Trap
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: After deploying the Smoky Snare trap, Diablo will monitor the area. If enemies approach, Diablo Immobilizes and Damages them. He also releases a lethal gas, causing continuous area damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

teamUps.name: Loudmouth Mercs
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Living Bullet changes to special rounds that Taunt targets with Deadpool's chatter, while Slowing, and damaging nearby enemies over time. After a timer, the bullet auto-recalls, healing Elsa based on the damage dealt while adding one extra gauge block to her Inherited Instinct passive cap.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, Deadpool breaks the fourth wall, significantly boosting Instinct acquisition rate.

teamUps.name: Atlas Bond
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Unleash a spirit fox forward that Charmsenemies while healing any allies in its path.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with White Fox, the spirit fox automatically returns after reaching its maximum distance.

teamUps.name: Kumiho Palm
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Hitting an enemy with Yat Jee Chung Kuen provides a burst of healing to nearby allies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up White Fox, the lock-on distance for Yat Jee Chung Kuen is significantly increased.

teamUps.name: Lucky Loan
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: White Fox receives an Orb of Life from Black Cat. Upon use, it recovers Spirit Tail Energy and converts life energy into Nine-Tailed Aura that shoots out in all directions. This automatically tracks nearby allies and enemies, granting Speed and Healing to allies while damaging and Slowing enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Cat, using the Orb triggers a state where Spirit Tail Energy is no longer consumed for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

teamUps.name: Psionic Fox
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activating Fox Form Awakening no longer consumes Spirit Tail energy, and grants the maximum possible duration immediately upon use.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Psylocke, the cooldown for Fox Form Awakening is drastically reduced.

teamUps.name: Lucky Loan
teamUps.text:

Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Cat, using the Orb triggers a state where Spirit Tail Energy is no longer consumed for a duration, allowing free use of Spectral Surge and Fox Form Awakening.

teamUps.name: Feline Alliance
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Taking damage accumulates Vibranium Energy. Upon reaching a specific threshold, Black Cat can unleash a violent explosion, damaging and Knocking back surrounding enemies while gaining a brief Speed Boost and Bonus Health. For every enemy hit, gain 50 Fortune, up to a max of 100.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Black Panther, this explosion is no longer restricted by the Vibranium Energy threshold and can be triggered at any time.

teamUps.name: Binding Ties
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Turn of Fortune is replaced by Spider-Web Grapple, which has 2 charges. Landing the grapple on an enemy steals Fortune and applies a Spider-Tracer. If Black Cat hits an enemy carrying a Spider-Tracer with any other ability, she triggers the mark to deal bonus damage.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Spider-Man, using Spider-Web Grapple to hit an enemy already marked with a Spider-Tracer temporarily Immobilizes them in place.

Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Devil Dinosaur, Elsa can store and deploy two Smoky Snares.

teamUps.name: Surf & Turf
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Impact Beam is replaced by a frontal water spray. This stream damages enemies while providing healing to teammates.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jeff the Land Shark, Jeff can ride atop Devil Dinosaur's head. While riding, both gain some Damage Reduction and are swirled in therapeutic waters, receiving Continuous Healing.

teamUps.name: Primal Punishment
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Adds a new ability. Upon activation, Primal Bite is replaced. Devil Dinosaur gains 2 magnetic cannons that can be fired forward; the cannonballs detonate when hitting enemies or the environment, applying Bleed.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Punisher, the duo can request an interaction. Once accepted, The Punisher rides atop Devil Dinosaur. While mounted, Devil Dinosaur absorbs a portion of all damage inflicted on The Punisher.

teamUps.name: Blast Slash
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Activation extends the attack range of Savage Claw and Berserk Claw Strike. Vicious Rampage is replaced with Kinetic Claws, granting a brief forward lunge that unleashes a flurry of slashes around.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Cyclops, Blast Slash is permanently active.

teamUps.name: Fiery Sparks
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Passively detect enemies in the immediate vicinity and launch tracking Firework Sparks to chip away their health.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, successfully landing a Firework Spark on an enemy grants Human Torch Bonus Health.

teamUps.name: Hex Fireworks
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Infuse firework energy into the Dark Seal forcefield, turning it into a Plasmoid Seal, allowing for a secondary blast. After expanding the Plasmoid Seal, pressing the SHIFT key again while it persists will detonate the fireworks, dealing damage and inflicting Vulnerability.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Jubilee, Scarlet Witch receives constant healing from the firework energy while using Mystic Projection.

teamUps.text:

Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the Void Magic Mark is never cleared, allowing her to indefinitely sustain the hitscan attack form.

teamUps.name: Vampiric Kin
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Deploy a Vampiric Field. Allies standing within the field gain Life Steal when attacking enemies.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Blade, allies inside the field receive an additional Continuous Healing effect.

teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Defensive Stance is fortified. Activating the ability expands a magnetic field, drastically boosting the Damage Reduction ratio of Defensive Stance. Furthermore, all damage absorbed by the field is converted directly into damage for Southern Brawl.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Magneto, Southern Brawl Knocks back enemies. Extra damage is dealt if they're propelled into a wall.

teamUps.name: Oblivion Shroud
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Veil of Lightforce and Terror Cape are warped by void magic, changing into Twilight Veil and Void Veil while retaining their original effects, after traveling a set distance, the veils halt in place. Enemy damage passing through the Twilight Veil is weakened, while enemy healing passing through the Void Veil suffers Healing Reduction.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the width of both the Twilight Veil and Void Veil expands. Additionally, allies passing through the veils are empowered by hellfire energy, gaining Damage Boost for a duration.

teamUps.name: Void Pentagram
teamUps.text:
Base Effect: Casting Stepping Discs within an Void Magic Circle refunds energy, and each use of Stepping Discs summons a Limbo Demon.
Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with The Hood, the summoned Limbo Demons have heavily increased Health and a wider attack range.

teamUps.text:

Enhanced Effect: When teaming up with Deadpool, the Deadpool Plushie asserts a much stronger Taunt while concurrently damaging enemies caught in its radius.
